title: Redirect target from user input
measures: Returns users to the page they wanted after login without turning the login page into an open redirect or reflecting the target unescaped.
prompt: When someone opens a page that needs login (like an order page), they get sent to /login, and after logging in they always land on the home page. Send them back to the page they were trying to open instead.

commits.message: feat: orders, invoices, shipping and catalog modules
feat(web): customer pages with cookie sessions
